text:
TAQAT AL-YAWN AL-AAMMAH
Inna hadha al-yawm yahtadi bi-nujum tushriq bi-taqa ijabiyyah khassah tatawafaq ma'a tabiatika al-munsifah ya burq al-mizan. Tashurru al-yawm bi-raghbah amiqah fi ijad al-wazn al-mithali bayna amalatika al-yawmiyyah wa rahatika al-nafsiyyah, mima yaj'al al-ajwa al-muhitah bika akthar huduan wa safa. Ruhuka al-mutafa'ilah tastaqbilu al-ahdath al-jadidah bi-sadr rahb, wa tunthiru laka al-aflak bi-yawm mali' bi-al-furs al-latifati allati tu'idu ilayka al-bahejah wa al-itminan al-dakhili.

AL-ISHQ WA AL-ALAQAT
Idha kunta murtabitan, fa-hadha al-yawm yumaththilu fursatan thaminatan li-ta'ziz al-tawasul al-ammiq ma'a al-sharik wa hall ayi سوء تفاهم sabiq bi-rikkat wa hifaz ala al-wihdah al-qalbiyyah. Amma lil-uzzaab, fa-inna al-nujum tulmiqu bi-imkaniyyati liqa' ghayr mutawaqqaq qad yuharriku mashaira jadidah wa yajlibu al-farah ila qalbika al-latif, fa-kun musta'iddan li-istiqbal al-hubb bi-qalb maftuh.

AL-AMAL WA AL-KARIYR
Ala al-mustawa al-mihni, tastati'u al-yawm bi-fadhl dhibka al-diblumasi al-muta'alliq an tahulla aqda al-mashaquil bi-sukoon wa thiqah. Tahnudu laka al-fursu li-taqdimi afkar ibda'iyyah thaminah tunalu irza'a al-ru'asa' wa ta'zizu makanataka bayna zumalailika, fa-la taratad fi ibraz mawahibika al-fariqah.

AL-MAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Tudhiru al-mu'amalat al-maliyyah al-yawm istiqraran malhuzan, ma yujlibu ila qalbika al-raha al-maliyyah allati antat biha. Innahu waqt munasib li-tatweer khuttah maliyyah thabitah aw li-dirasati istithmar jadid yuda'ifu barakat rizqika, ma damta tastakhdiru al-hikmah fi al-infaq wa tatajannabu al-ishraf ghayr al-daruri.

AL-SIHHA WA AL-TAQA
Sihhatuka al-badaniyyah wa al-nafsiyyah tastafidu kathiran min al-taqa al-muhitah bika al-yawm, fa-anta tastati'u an tastariha a'sabaka bi-mumarasati al-riyadah al-khafifah aw al-tamammul fi al-tabi'ah. Unsihka bi-shurbi kamiyyat kafiyyah min al-mael wa al-ihtimam bi-nawmi al-layl li-i'adati shahn taqatika al-kamilah lil-ayyam al-muqbila.

AL-TAWASUL WA AL-MUHIT
Tuhiytu al-yawm bi-shabakah dafi'ah min al-asdiqa' wa al-a'ilah alladhina yamnahunaka al-da'm al-nafsi al-lazim wa yusharikunaka lahazat al-dahka wa al-uns. Inna al-liqa'at al-ijtima'iyyah al-qasirah aw al-muhadathat al-iatiyyah ma'a al-muqarrabin satukunu masdaran li-tarfiyyah al-qalb wa tajdid al-nasheet.

NASIHAT AL-YAWN
Da' al-tamamiyyah al-mut'iba janiban, fa-al-jamal yakmanu fi al-tawazun wa al-rida bi-ma yaktubuhu al-qadar laka kull yawm.

TAFASEEL AL-YAWN
Al-raqm al-mahzuz: 6. Al-lawn al-mahzuz: Al-azraq al-samawi. Al-burj al-mutawafiq: Burj al-Jawza'.
